The full new local word-collapse proofs separately factor the complete piecewise sum and its incompatible correction, track coefficient reversal/prime paths in noncommuting order, handle degree-one boundary cases, and prove exact cancellation intertwines mutation with the grading transformation. This multi-stage blocking classification and noncommutative cancellation induction is substantially beyond ordinary qualification arguments; it is not replaced by assuming the target Laurent phenomenon.
